units.source_text: 公寓窗外，附近的電線上掛著一隻風箏，被春天夾雜著塵埃的風吹得破爛不堪，

en.t: Outside the apartment window, a kite was caught on the nearby power lines, battered to tatters by the dusty spring wind,

units.source_text: 但還是死纏著電線不放，彷彿在不停地頻頻點頭。

en.t: yet it still clung stubbornly to the wires, as if it were nodding over and over without stopping.

units.source_text: 每每看見這一幕，我都忍不住苦笑、臉紅，甚至還會做噩夢。

en.t: Whenever I saw it, I could not help smiling bitterly and blushing, and I even had nightmares about it.

units.source_text: 「很多……俗話說‘財竭緣盡’，此話一點不假啊。」

en.t: A lot. As the saying goes, when the money runs out, the relationship ends, and it is absolutely true.

units.source_text: 「別說蠢話了。這不過是老掉牙的……」

en.t: Do not be ridiculous. That is just some worn-out old saying...

units.source_text: 「是嗎？看來你不懂，再這麼下去，沒準兒我會逃走的。」

en.t: Is that so? It seems you do not understand. If this keeps up, I may well run away.

units.source_text: 「到底是誰窮，又是誰要逃走呢？你真奇怪啊。」

en.t: Which one of us is poor, and which one is supposed to run away? You really are strange.

units.source_text: 「我要自己賺錢，用自己賺來的錢買酒、買菸。

en.t: I want to earn money myself, and use the money I earn to buy liquor and cigarettes.
